subject: *: check delete unique key's handle to handle corner case (#52975)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent (DDL/add-index focus). Main behavior change is in `pkg/table/tables/index.go` unique-index deletion: during add-index merge/backfill (`BackfillState != Inapplicable`), it reads the current unique-index value and only deletes the key if the stored handle matches the row handle being deleted, preventing accidental deletion of a newer/covered (ingested/double-written) unique key (#52914). DDL-side changes in `pkg/ddl/index.go` and `pkg/ddl/ingest/backend.go` are test-only failpoint hooks (no production behavior impact when failpoints are disabled). No plausible remaining Blocker/High issues found for correctness, consistency, concurrency, or DDL metadata/state handling in the touched paths.
